y-m-47-01.title: Oko isiphumo sophando sodwa sikuxela kwaye singakuxeli
y-m-47-01.topic: Inani lamalungu emanyano, nokuba ulwazi luyanela na
y-m-47-01.goal: Gweba ukuba ulwazi malunga nenani lamalungu eeseti luyanela na, uphucule isiphelo nolwandlalo lwamaxabiso anokwenzeka xa kufika ulwazi olutsha, uze wenze imeko egcwalisa zonke iimeko ngokwakho.
y-m-47-01.material: Abafundi abangama-40 bebanga lokuqala esikolweni bahlolwa ngokuba benza imisebenzi 'ukuqubha' kunye 'nokubaleka'. Umfundi unokwenza zombini imisebenzi, okanye angenzi nanye. Utitshala oyintloko ukuxelela iziphumo zophando inyathelo ngenyathelo. Gweba ukuba ulwazi olunikiweyo lukuvumela ukuba umisele 'inani labafundi abenza ukuqubha nokubaleka kunye'. (n(A) ithetha inani lamalungu eseti A kwaye ifundwa 'n ka-A'.)
y-m-47-01.thinking.2: Ukwenza ngokwakho iimeko ezigcwalisa zonke iimeko nokuhlola uluhlu olunokwenzeka
y-m-47-01.prereq.0: Umfundi uyazi intsingiselo yeeseti, imanyano nesidibaniso, nophawu n(A) lwenani lamalungu (I-H1 yeli qela sisinyuko sobunzima nenkxaso kuphela kwaye ayithethi ukuba lilabelwe kwibanga elithile. Cinga ukuba umfundi ufunda icandelo 'leeSeti neZiphakamiso' leMathematika Eqhelekileyo yesikolo samabanga aphakamileyo.)
y-m-47-01.prereq.1: Amava okwahlula nokubala amalungu ngaphandle kokudibana usebenzisa imizobo kaVenn okanye iitheyibhile
y-m-47-01.s.s1.prompt: Utitshala ukuxelela iziphumo zophando enye ngexesha. Ixesha ngalinye xa kufika ulwazi olutsha, phinda uhlole isigwebo sakho ngo-'nani labafundi abenza zombini'.
y-m-47-01.s.s1.hint.0: Kumgca omnye, bhala ukuba inkcukacha nganye ikuxelela ntoni ngamaqela amane 'ukuqubha kuphela, ukubaleka kuphela, zombini, akukho nanye'.
y-m-47-01.s.s1.hint.1: Zama ukufaka amanani ukuze amaqela amane adibane abe ngama-40, uze uvavanye ukuba ahambelana nolwazi.
y-m-47-01.s.s1.st.0.info: Abafundi abama-25 bayaqubha, abafundi abama-22 bayabaleka, kwaye abafundi abama-40 iyonke baphendule kuphando.
y-m-47-01.s.s1.st.0.ask: Bangaphi abafundi abenza ukuqubha nokubaleka kunye?
y-m-47-01.s.s1.st.0.after: Akumiselwanga. Ukuba akukho namnye wenza nanye, abafundi aba-7 bayadibana, kwaye ukuba kukho abafundi abangenzi nanye, abafundi abaninzi bayadibana. Amaxabiso anokwenzeka anokucutha abe ngabafundi aba-7 okanye ngaphezulu nabafundi abama-22 okanye ngaphantsi. 'Akumiselwanga njengexabiso elinye' kunye 'nesazi uluhlu' azichaseni.
y-m-47-01.s.s1.st.0.r.a: Amanani amabini adibaniswe angaphezulu kwetotali engama-40, kwaye usenokuba awukasebenzi ukuba loo mahluko uthetha ntoni.
y-m-47-01.s.s1.st.0.o.b: Ukuba siyilinganisa ibe ngama-40, imiselwe njengo-7
y-m-47-01.s.s1.st.0.r.b: Ukuba ubale 25+22−40, uthathe ukuba bonke abafundi abama-40 benza ubuncinane enye yemisebenzi emibini. Jonga umva ukuba ulwazi olunjalo lwanikwa na.
y-m-47-01.s.s1.st.0.r.d: Isigwebo sokuba akumiselwanga sivumelekile. Kodwa jonga ukuba uluhlu lwamaxabiso anokwenzeka lunokucuthwa ngemiqobo ye-25, 22, netotali engama-40 kuphela.
y-m-47-01.s.s1.st.1.info: Isiphumo sohlolo siye safika. Bonke abafundi abama-40 benza ubuncinane ukuqubha okanye ukubaleka.
y-m-47-01.s.s1.st.1.ask: Ngoku bangaphi abafundi abenza imisebenzi yombini?
y-m-47-01.s.s1.st.1.after: Bonke abafundi abama-40 benza ubuncinane enye yezi zimbini, ngoko inani labafundi abangenzi nanye li-0. Emva koko u-7, onguka-25+22=47 ukhutshe itotali engama-40, linani labafundi ababalwe kabini, oko kukuthi abafundi abenza imisebenzi yombini.
y-m-47-01.s.s1.st.1.r.b: Phinda ufunde into ekuxelelwa yona yilo lwazi lutsha malunga 'nabafundi abangenzi nanye'.
y-m-47-01.s.s1.st.1.r.c: Landela ukuba i-18 yavela kweyiphi kwezi-40, 22, 25 nokuba linani labafundi abangaphi. Kufuneka uhlole ukuba lilingana nenani labafundi ofuna ukulifumana.
y-m-47-01.s.s1.st.1.r.d: I-22 lelona xabiso likhulu kwamaxabiso anokwenzeka. Hlola ukuba olu lwazi lutsha lwenza ibe lelo xabiso.
y-m-47-01.s.s1.st.2.info: Ukujonga imibuzo kwakhona, ama-3 ayebhalwe 'akenzi kuntywila okanye ukubaleka'. Ulwazi lwangaphambili 'bonke abafundi aba-40 benza ubuncinane into enye' lwalungalunganga. Ukuntywila 25, ukubaleka 22, kunye nesixa esingama-40 ziyahleli njengoko zinjalo.
y-m-47-01.s.s1.st.2.ask: Ngolwazi olulungisiweyo, bangaphi abafundi abenza zombini izinto?
y-m-47-01.s.s1.st.2.after: Inani labafundi abenza ubuncinane enye yezi zimbini li-40−3=37. Ukususa i-37 kwi-25+22=47 kunika abali-10 ababalwe kabini. Xa ulwazi lulungiswa, isigqibo esele sinikiwe (7) kufuneka silungiswe nasiso.
y-m-47-01.s.s1.st.2.r.a: Eli lixabiso elifunyenwe ngolwazi phambi kokulungiswa. Hlola ukuba uyibonise na ulwazi olulungisiweyo.
y-m-47-01.s.s1.st.2.r.c: Ukulungiswa kusixelele inani labafundi abangenzi nanye. Hlola ukuba isekhona na ingagqitywanga nangona ulwazi lukhulile.
y-m-47-01.s.s1.st.2.r.d: Ukuba i-3 yasuswa kwi-7, sebenza ngamanani ukuba inani labafundi ababalwe kabini litshintsha njani xa inani labafundi abangenzi nanye lonyuka.

y-m-47-07.s.s1.hint.1: Vavanya ngokwahlukeneyo ukuba nganye kwiicala ezimbini, ukusuka ku-p ukuya ku-q nokusuka ku-q ukuya ku-p, ihlala ibamba.

y-m-47-07.s.s2.hint.0: Khetha amanani amancinci a no-b, bhala iziphindaphindi ezimbalwa ze-a ne-b, uze ukhangele ubudlelwane bokubandakanya.

y-m-47-07.s.s2.fail.c1: a no-b kufuneka babe ngamanani aphelele ukusuka kwi-2 ukuya kwi-100.
y-m-47-07.s.s2.ok.c2: Isiphindaphindi ngasinye sika-a sisisiphindaphindi sika-b (imeko eyanelisayo).
y-m-47-07.s.s2.fail.c2: Ukuze zonke iziphindaphindi ze-a ziziphindaphindi ze-b, a kufuneka ibe sisiphindaphindi se-b. Khangela ukuba likho na isiphindaphindi sika-a esingeyiyo isiphindaphindi sika-b.
y-m-47-07.s.s2.ok.c3: Kukho inani elanelisa q kodwa hayi p (ayiyiyo imeko eyimfuneko).
y-m-47-07.s.s2.fail.c3: Ukuba a=b iimeko ezimbini ziyafana, ngoko iba yimeko eyimfuneko neyanelisayo.
y-m-47-07.s.s2.explain: Izibini ezifana ne-(12, 4), (6, 3), (10, 5), (9, 3) ziyenzeka. Ukuba a sisiphindaphindi sika-b kwaye ziyahluka, zonke iziphindaphindi sika-a ziziphindaphindi sika-b, kodwa b ngokwayo asisosiphindaphindi sika-a.
y-m-47-07.s.s2.because.prompt: Khetha enye yee-(a, b) zakho, uze ubhale ukuba kutheni 'ukuba p ngoko q' ihlala ibamba nomzekelo wenani elanelisa q kodwa hayi p.
y-m-47-07.s.s2.because.hint.0: Kwi-(a, b) oyikhethileyo, qala ubhale ukuba a ingabhalwa njani njenge-b amaxesha inani elithile.
y-m-47-07.s.s2.because.hint.1: Wahlula ngqo ukuhlola ukuba ingaba u-b ngokwakhe wanelisa u-p.
y-m-47-07.s.s2.because.selfAssess.0: Ingaba uhlolile ngokwahlula ukuba inani endilinikileyo liyisiphindaphindi senani lika-q hayi isiphindaphindi senani lika-p?
y-m-47-07.s.s2.because.selfAssess.1: Ingaba inkcazo yakho iquka ukuba 'isiphindaphindi sika-a sinemo yika-b amaxesha elinye inani'?
y-m-47-07.s.s2.because.model.0: Ndikhethe a=12, b=4. Isiphindaphindi se-12 sisoloko sisisiphindaphindi se-4 kuba 12=4×3. Kodwa u-4 sisiphindaphindi se-4 hayi isiphindaphindi se-12, ngoko ayiyiyo imeko efunekayo.

y-m-47-07.s.s2.because.model.2: Yi-(12, 3). Ekubeni 12=3×4, isiphindaphindi se-12 sisoloko sisisiphindaphindi se-3. Kodwa u-3 sisiphindaphindi se-3 hayi se-12.
y-m-47-07.s.s2.because.model.3: Sinokubhala a=b×k, ngoko isiphindaphindi sika-a siba sisiphindaphindi sika-b. U-b ngokwakhe wanelisa u-q kodwa akanelisi u-p.
y-m-47-07.s.s3.prompt: Ukuba utshintshisa u-a no-b womnye umbini owenzileyo kwinyathelo elingentla uze uvumele p: x sisiphindaphindi sika-b, q: x sisiphindaphindi sika-a, u-p ubuya kuba yimeko enjani ku-q? (Cinga ukuba u-a sisiphindaphindi sika-b kwaye bahlukile.)
y-m-47-07.s.s3.hint.0: Faka amanani athile afana no-(a, b)=(12, 4) uze ubhale uluhlu lweziphindaphindi zika-p no-q otshintshisiweyo.
y-m-47-07.s.s3.hint.1: Hlola icala: iziphindaphindi zeziphi zonke zibandakanyiwe kwiziphindaphindi zenye.
y-m-47-07.s.s3.r.a: Xa u-p ziziphindaphindi zika-b kwaye u-q ziziphindaphindi zika-a, vavanya ukuba u-b, umzekelo ka-p, wanelisa u-q na.
y-m-47-07.s.s3.r.c: Vavanya ukuba, ngo-a no-b abahlukileyo, iziphindaphindi zeemeko ezimbini zinokuba zifanayo na.
y-m-47-07.s.s3.r.d: Vavanya ngamanani athile ukuba inyaniso yokuba u-a sisiphindaphindi sika-b yenza ubudlelwane bokubandakanywa obuthini phakathi kweemeko ezimbini.
y-m-47-07.s.s3.explain: Ukuba u-a sisiphindaphindi sika-b kwaye bahlukile, wonke isiphindaphindi sika-a sisisiphindaphindi sika-b. Emva kokutshintshisa, wonke isiphindaphindi sika-q sisisiphindaphindi sika-p, ngoko 'ukuba q ngoko p', oko kukuthi, u-p yimeko efunekayo. Kodwa u-b wanelisa u-p kwaye akanelisi u-q, ngoko ayiyiyo imeko eneleyo.

y-m-47-09.s.s1.st.0.after: x=2 ukunganeliseli imeko kuthetha kuphela 'x=2 akenzi S ibe yinyani'. Usenokuba nemvakalelo yokuba ibonakala ixoki. 'Ezinye' zinyanisile ukuba likho nelinye ixabiso elinelisayo, ngoko ukuba amaxabiso angavavanywanga asele, awunakugqiba.

y-m-47-09.s.s1.st.1.ask: Inani lamaxabiso avavanyiweyo likhule laya kwi-5. Sesiphi isigwebo sakho ngo-S ngoku?
y-m-47-09.s.s1.st.1.after: Nokuba onke amaxabiso avavanyiweyo ahlulekile, ukuba amaxabiso angavavanywanga asele, S ayigqitywanga. Usenokuba nemvakalelo yokuba ibonakala ixoki, kodwa oko asiyongqiniso. Ukuze ugqibe, kufuneka ubonise ukuba kutheni imeko iphuka kuwo onke amanani enyani.
y-m-47-09.s.s1.st.1.r.a: Sebenza ukuba kuqinisekisiwe na ukuba phakathi kwamaxabiso angengawo ama-5 avavanyiweyo, akukho elinelisa imeko.
y-m-47-09.s.s1.st.1.r.d: Hlola ukuba ixabiso elisebenzayo liyavela na.
y-m-47-09.s.s1.st.2.ask: Ukusuka kwesi siphumo sovavanyo, sesiphi isigwebo sakho ngo-S?
y-m-47-09.s.s1.st.2.after: 'Kwenye x, ...' inyanisile ukuba likho nelinye x elisebenzayo. Isebenza kwi-x=0.5, ngoko nokuba mingaphi amaxabiso ahlulekileyo ngaphambili, S inyanisile.
y-m-47-09.s.s1.st.2.o.a: S ixoki. Ayizange isebenze kwi-x ezininzi
y-m-47-09.s.s1.st.2.r.a: Hlola okwenzekayo ukuba likho nelinye ixabiso elisebenzayo, hayi 'ezininzi'.
y-m-47-09.s.s1.st.2.r.c: Ixabiso elisebenzayo livele ngokwenene. Funda kwakhona ukuba eli xabiso linempembelelo ni kwintsingiselo yesivakalisi S.
y-m-47-09.s.s1.reflect: Ekuqaleni sasingakwazi ukugweba, kwaye nangona imizekelo ehlulekayo yabuthelana ayizange 'igqitywe', kodwa xa kwavela umzekelo omnye osebenzayo yagqitywa. Thelekisa indlela umsebenzi womzekelo omnye owahluka ngayo phakathi kwesivakalisi esine 'ezinye' nesivakalisi esine 'zonke'.
y-m-47-09.s.s2.prompt: Lelipi ukuphika okufanelekileyo kwesivakalisi S: 'Kwenye inani lenyani x, x²<x'?
y-m-47-09.s.s2.hint.0: Vavanya nge-x=0.5 nge-x=2 ukuba S nesivakalisi esikukhetho zinokuba zombini zinyanisile ngaxeshanye na.
y-m-47-09.s.s2.hint.1: Vavanya nge-x=0 ukuba uphawu lokungalingani kufuneka lutshintshe njani xa utshintsha 'ezinye' zibe 'zonke'.
y-m-47-09.s.s2.o.a: Kuwo onke amanani enyani x, x²>x
y-m-47-09.s.s2.r.a: Hlola ukuba ukuphika kwe '<' kuyi '>'. Ubudlelwane phakathi kuka-x² no-x buthini xa x=0?
y-m-47-09.s.s2.r.b: Yashiya 'ezinye' njengoko zinjalo yatshintsha kuphela uphawu lokungalingani. Hlola ukuba x=2 yenza esi sivakalisi sibe yinyani na, nokuba sinokuba kukuphika kuka-S.
y-m-47-09.s.s2.r.c: Hlola ukuba S nesi sivakalisi zinokuba zombini zinyanisile na.
y-m-47-09.s.s2.o.d: Kuwo onke amanani enyani x, x²≥x
y-m-47-09.s.s2.explain: Ukuphika kwe 'kukho ... ethile' ngu 'kuyo yonke ..., akunjalo'. Ukuphika kwe x²<x yi-x²≥x (kubandakanya x²=x), ngoko 'kuwo onke amanani enyani x, x²≥x' kukuphika. Ngokungqina, S inyanisile, ngoko oku kuphika kuxoki. x=0.5 ngumzekelo ochasayo.
y-m-47-09.s.s3.prompt: Ukubonisa ukuba S inyanisile, ufuna u-x omnye owanelisa imeko. Fumana amanani enyani ama-3 ahlukeneyo x anelisa x²<x.
y-m-47-09.s.s3.hint.0: Faka inani eliphakathi kuka-0 no-1 elinje ngo-x=0.5 uze ubale x² no-x ngokwahlukeneyo.
y-m-47-09.s.s3.hint.1: Tshintsha u-x phakathi kuka-0 no-1 uze ufumane uluhlu apho x² iba ncinci kuno-x.
y-m-47-09.s.s3.fail.c1: x²<x ayisebenzi. Faka 0.1, 0.5, 2, njalo njalo endaweni ka-x uze uthelekise x² no-x.
y-m-47-09.s.s3.explain: Onke amanani enyani aphakathi kuka-0 no-1 anokwenzeka. Ukuba x ngu-0 okanye u-1, x²=x, kwaye ukuba x mkhulu kuno-1 okanye unegethivu, x²>x.
